definitions.gloss: Chinese person; Chinese national; a person from China
definitions.explanation: A person whose nationality is Chinese (the People's Republic of China), or who is ethnically Chinese. The term is used in the same neutral way as {日本人|にほんじん} or アメリカ{人|じん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}です。
{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅行客|りょこうきゃく}→旅行客：25762_ryokoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many Chinese tourists at sightseeing spots.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: Several Chinese colleagues work at my company.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧ (China) and the suffix {〜人|じん} (person of a country), following the standard pattern for nationality nouns.

USAGE:
- Refers to Chinese nationals (citizens of the People's Republic of China) or to ethnic Chinese people. Context usually makes it clear which is meant.
- In casual spoken Japanese, people may also say ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧, which is slightly softer and more conversational.
- The suffix {〜人|じん} is pronounced /jin/ after most country names (e.g., ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧, {韓国人|かんこくじん}, {中国人|ちゅうごくじん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中国人|ちゅうごくじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧: Chinese tourists
- {中国人|ちゅうごくじん}⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧: Chinese exchange student
- ⟦{在日|ざいにち}→在日：20684_zainichi⟧{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}: Chinese residents of Japan
- {中国人|ちゅうごくじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧: a Chinese friend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧: Japanese person — same pattern with ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧
- {韓国人|かんこくじん}: Korean person (South Korea) — same pattern with ⟦{韓国|かんこく}→韓国：19417_kankoku⟧
- {台湾人|たいわんじん}: Taiwanese person — a person from Taiwan
- {華僑|かきょう}: overseas Chinese — ethnic Chinese living outside China, a more specialized term
